dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sir, we don't forbid exhibitors from offering drink samples, but I need to make sure you understand what you're getting into.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Any samples you offer are at your own risk. If anything goes wrong, like if a customer has a bad reaction to one of your products, the expo can't take any responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: Rest assured, Ma'am, what you see here is 100 percent pure Mondstadt vintage. Straight from the Dawn Winery's cellars, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Wowee. You don't often find Mondstadt wine this far away from home.

dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: You're telling me... If you try to ship this stuff through the proper channels, all the taxes and tariffs would send the prices skyrocketing.

dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: But that's where my connections come in! With me, you get Mondstadt wine at Mondstadt prices!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, hey. You can't go around asking people questions like that!
